title: Red Hill Community Market (temporarily closed)
summary: The original Red Hill Community Market is temporarily closed. Its organiser says it will not run until a new location is found.
editorVerdict: Closed until the organiser announces a new location.
editorNote: The original Red Hill Community Market, run by Craft Markets Australia, is temporarily closed. It is distinct from the Hill and Ridge Community Market at Red Hill Recreation Reserve. Check the organiser before planning a visit.

heroImage.alt: Red Hill Market stalls on a first Saturday morning

retiredSourceLinks.note: The domain resolves to a NetRegistry redirector that answers 200 with the two-word body 'Not found'. EDITOR, and this is the important one: the Red Hill Community Market's own site now reads 'The Red Hill Community Market is temporarily closed' and serves only a history archive. The market trading at Red Hill Recreation Reserve on the first Saturday September-May is the Hill & Ridge Community Market, run by the Red Hill Agricultural & Horticultural Society. This site holds them as two separate things and says so in prose.
